python - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess, json, time, ctypes, ctypes.util
D=pathlib.Path('/workspace/diagnostics')
for name in ['gtk-install.log','gtk-apt-update.log','gtk-package-versions.log']:
 p=D/name
 if p.exists(): print(name, p.read_text()[-5000:])
print('OS',pathlib.Path('/etc/os-release').read_text())
deadline=json.loads((D/'gtk-repair-start.json').read_text())['deadline_epoch']
report={'deadline_epoch':deadline,'commands':[]}
for label,cmd in [('gtk-refresh',['apt-get','update']),('gtk-runtime-install',['apt-get','install','-y','--no-install-recommends','libgtk-3-0'])]:
 remaining=deadline-time.time()
 if remaining<=5: report['failure']='Preflight deadline exhausted';break
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=min(55,remaining-3))
  (D/(label+'.log')).write_text(p.stdout)
  report['commands'].append({'command':cmd,'returncode':p.returncode,'log':label+'.log'})
  print(label,p.returncode,p.stdout[-5000:])
  if p.returncode:break
 except Exception as e:report['failure']=repr(e);break
try:
 name=ctypes.util.find_library('gtk-3');lib=ctypes.CDLL(name or 'libgtk-3.so.0')
 report['gtk_resolution']={'soname':name,'loaded':True,'version':'.'.join(str(getattr(lib,'gtk_get_'+v+'_version')()) for v in ['major','minor','micro'])}
except Exception as e:report['gtk_resolution']={'loaded':False,'exception':repr(e)}
p=subprocess.run(['dpkg-query','-W','-f=${Package}\t${Version}\t${Architecture}\n','libgtk-3-0*','libglib2.0-0*','libc6'],capture_output=True,text=True)
report['package_versions']=p.stdout;report['package_query_stderr']=p.stderr
report['finished_epoch']=time.time()
(D/'gtk-targeted-repair.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
PY
